prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil minor lipid components including tocopherols can be characterized using HPLC-MS techniques, and GC-MS can be used to monitor volatile markers, to identify compositional factors affecting oxidative degradation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"Triacylglycerol molecular species were profiled by HPLC-MS in positive ion mode"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol and phytosterol contents were minimally affected up to 140 °C"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-04877","field":"abstract","quote":"Maillard-derived alkylpyrazines, monitored as volatile markers by SPME-GC-MS"}]}]}
